text_block_list.name: Dog
text_block_list.text: Yip, yip!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, I'm so sorry! Did I startle you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*. It's mysterious every single time.
Why do animals get so terrified of you?
Even though you like animals so much, Creek-san.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Indeed~.
Just the other day at the zoo, even a lion looked away from me...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
First time hearing that...
You're on a whole other level.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Here. Creek-san, take this.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My, is this a puppy-raising game?!
Taishin-chan... could this be for me—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...It's not. It just happened to be cheap at a secondhand shop.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Might not be much comfort, but in a game, they won't be scared of you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Taishin-chan...
I'll do my absolute best to care for it!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
—Ta-da! 
It's dinosaur jerky~♪ 
I'm sure this will make you ha—

text_block_list.name: Game Dog
text_block_list.text: *Grrrrrrrrrr...!*

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, goodness—! 
Hmm, is he still frightened of me after all...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No, there's no way it shouldn't make progress...
Let me try.

text_block_list.name: Game Dog
text_block_list.text: *Pant pant! Yap yap, whiiine♡*

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, so easy...
I did the exact same thing Creek-san did, so how...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Does Creek-san's heavyweight aura bleed through even in games...? No way, that's ridiculous.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Taishin-chan. Can we play this game outside as well?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I think he's only frightened because we haven't had enough time to get to know each other yet.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: So, I'm going to spend way, waaaay more time with this little guy!

text_block_list.name: Game Dog
text_block_list.text: *Bark! Grrrrr...*

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, you must be hungry~.
I'll feed you right now, so please wait just a moment~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Look at that cafe, you can bring dogs inside~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Look, isn't it wonderful~?
Let's have tea together there someday~♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
Training is all done, so let's go on our evening walk~!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, walks are so fun~.
At this hour, we get to meet other pups out on their walks too~.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Hah. Seriously, Creek-san, you're unbelievable.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my, where did that come from?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's just a game dog, but you do it every single day. 
Meals right on schedule, 
two walks a day without ever skipping.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Normal people wouldn't go that far.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I decided to take care of this little one. 
So I want to give it my all with all my heart.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just a game, 
and even if he keeps hating me forever, 
I simply don't want to give up halfway~.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. 
Well, I guess that is just like you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu.♪ 
I'll do my best so that someday 
we can become the best of friends~.

text_block_list.name: Game Dog
text_block_list.text: *Yip! ...Whimper~*
